title: ListingProgramSettingsDocument
description: The programmatic listings pause switch (Settings → Intake). One document, listingProgramSettings/platform; absent means not paused. While paused, adminNominateOrganizer refuses every nomination and listing approval refuses any listing Catch sourced itself (a nomination or discovery); an organizer's own submission and website instant drafts are unaffected. A stored document that fails this contract also refuses. Server-only; written by adminManageListingProgram. Every write bumps revision.

reason.description: Why the switch was last flipped; shown with the refusal.
